tile.compliance_2025: In the first year of its new policy, nearly four in five Gates-funded publications complied, most without the foundation paying a publishing fee.
tile.preprints_lmic_2025: Almost two in three Gates-funded preprints in 2025 had an author based in a low- or middle-income country, up from just over half in 2024 and in line with the foundation’s focus on global health research funding.
tile.head_start_median_2025: By promoting preprints, the foundation helps findings reach others sooner: in 2025, preprinted research was public a median of 7.6 months before its journal article.

comparison.preprints_and_cc_by_share: Grantees are preprinting more, and getting it right. In the policy’s second year, 78% of preprints met the policy so far in 2026, up from 65% at this point in 2025.
comparison.preprint_growth: Grantees are turning to preprints to share their findings sooner. Preprints rose by 80% in the first year of the new policy.
comparison.lmic_authors: More Gates-funded research includes authors in low- and middle-income countries, in line with the foundation’s focus on global health research funding. Since the new policy began, 12% more publications have included them, now two in three of the total.

compliance.text: The foundation is getting more research out for less. Now that the policy covers preprints too, 78% of Gates-funded publications complied in 2025. Preprints rose by 80%, and spending on publishing fees (APCs) more than halved.
compliance.audience: For external audiences, such as grantees and other funders visiting the foundation’s Open Access policy page.

compliant_without_apcs.text: Open research is costing the foundation less. In 2025, 83% of compliant publications met the policy without a publishing fee (APC), up from 56% in 2024.
compliant_without_apcs.audience: For external audiences, such as grantees and other funders visiting the foundation’s Open Access policy page.

apc_spend.text: The new policy is saving the foundation money. It spent US$2.8M less on publishing fees (APCs) in 2025 than in 2024, even though the typical fee rose by 14%.
apc_spend.audience: For internal reporting, such as newsletters sent to staff or annual reports.
